title: Replication: Z32 under the single best width-10 column order from explore.807
motivation: explore.807.z32.columnar10 (60 random width-10 column orders) gave p=0.01 against 99 nulls (z=3.6), exploratory Holm p=1.0 over ~160 testable screens, so likely chance. This re-tests the single best order (3-6-7-5-9-1-4-8-0-2) as one pre-registered confirmatory test with fresh seeds, staged nulls and 50 genuine-text controls. Decision rule: counts only if it reaches an alert (Holm p<0.05 in the confirmatory family with power>=0.5); otherwise the screen result is recorded as not replicated.
